name: Zoho CRM (Zia)
summary: Full-featured CRM with the Zia AI assistant.
description: Zoho CRM manages leads, deals, campaigns and customer service. Its Zia assistant predicts close likelihood, detects anomalies, suggests best contact times and answers questions about your data.
summary_fr: CRM complet avec l'assistant IA Zia.
description_fr: Zoho CRM gère prospects, affaires, campagnes et service client. Son assistant Zia prédit les chances de conclure, détecte les anomalies, suggère les meilleurs moments de contact et répond aux questions sur les données.
